findings.description: Response.__init__ now assigns self.reason from self.raw.reason, but self.raw is None when a Response is constructed directly, so this raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any code path that calls Response() with no raw object, such as building an empty Response for tests or synthetic responses. Mechanism: the constructor reads an attribute of None at this line, before raw is populated by the adapter. Impact: instantiating Response() crashes instead of returning an object with reason unset, and the reason type was also changed to non-optional str, so the empty case is no longer represented.
